intents.name: greeting
responses: 👋 Welcome to **VeriCart**! I'm your AI-powered return assistant. I can help you with product returns, refunds, and quality verification. What would you like to do today?

intents.name: return_initiate
responses: I'll help you with your return request! 📦 To get started, please provide your **Order ID** (e.g., ORD001, ORD002, etc.).

intents.name: order_status
responses: Sure! Please share your **Order ID** and I'll look it up for you.

intents.name: reason_damage
responses: I understand the product appears damaged. To verify the condition, I'll need to analyze a photo of the item. Please upload a clear image of the product below. 📸

intents.name: reason_defect
responses: I'm sorry to hear that! To process this defect claim, I need to visually inspect the product. Please upload a clear photo of the item below. 📸

intents.name: reason_wrong
responses: I'll verify that the received product matches your order. Please upload a clear photo of the item you received so our AI can cross-check it. 📸

intents.name: reason_quality
responses: Our advanced AI system will scan the product for quality and authenticity issues. Please upload a clear photo of the product. 📸

intents.name: goodbye
responses: Thank you for contacting VeriCart! 😊 Your request has been logged. Have a great day!
